title: Approve Chat composition
question: High-Density Module Mosaic is locked. Pick the Chat first-viewport composition to build against (comp-led).

options.label: Three-column mosaic
options.thesis: History, structured answer, and citations as three abutting ruled columns with red header tabs.
options.viewport: Left conversation history, center structured answer + composer, right citation list and language toggle.
options.risk: Three equal columns can compete; citations may steal the answer.

options.label: Two-row mosaic
options.thesis: History as a thin top strip; answer and citations share the main row; composer is a full-width bottom module.
options.viewport: Top history strip, 70/30 answer vs citations, full-width composer with red Send.
options.risk: History strip may feel cramped on desktop.

options.label: Answer-dominant plate
options.thesis: One dominant structured-answer plate; citations live inside it as hairline fields; thin status rail for interview steps.
options.viewport: Almost full-width answer with inline citations; right rail for Step 2 of 3 and language.
options.risk: Drops history from the first viewport; denser reading, less scan of past turns.
